scientific_integrity: Originality is claimed only for the explicit corona phase/basin classification and the sharp cycle–clique crossover. Standard NOR period bounds and elementary transfer-matrix machinery are acknowledged, not claimed new.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple undirected loopless base graphs and synchronous open-neighborhood NOR with one private pendant leaf per base vertex; exact crossover only between cycle and clique bases, not a universal extremal graph theorem. The 2012 foundational paper was not inspected in full; independently validated novelty and proof are not claimed.
title: Exact attraction basins of NOR leaf coronas and a cycle–clique crossover
